results.question: 上个月华东区复购率是多少？

gold_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(n >= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(order_id) AS n
  FROM orders
  WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND region_id = 'east'
    AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY customer_id
) AS t

actual.answer: 上个月（2026年9月），华东区的复购率为 17.9%（复购用户数 63 人，下单用户数 352 人）。
sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
  COUNT(*) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id AS customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_in_period
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN regions AS r
    ON o.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    AND r.region_name = '华东'
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id
) AS t
LIMIT 1000

results.question: 上个月各品类的毛利率

gold_sql:
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) / SUM(oi.pay_amount), 4)
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS paid_sales,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.pay_amount - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 0),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gross_margin DESC,
  category
LIMIT 1000
